questions.explanation: At 90° on the unit circle, the point is at the top (0,1). Sin is the y-coordinate, so sin(90°) = 1.
At 0°, the point is at (1,0). Cos is the x-coordinate, so cos(0°) = 1.

questions.questionText: What is the radius of the unit circle?
questions.explanation: The unit circle has radius = 1 by definition.

questions.questionText: Which identity is always true on the unit circle?
questions.explanation: The Pythagorean identity: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 holds for all angles on the unit circle.
At 180°, the point is at (-1, 0). Sin is the y-coordinate, so sin(180°) = 0.
